name: ActionDelegate
purpose: Expand a descendant primary control's pointer target while preserving native host semantics and independent controls.
useWhen: A record row or card has a real visible primary link, button or checkbox and ordinary background clicks should activate it.

avoidWhen.condition: The surface itself should be a normal button or link.

composition: Pass one non-Fragment host and targetId of its real visible descendant control; keep that control named and keyboard accessible.

rules.statement: Keep native row/list/card semantics and the actual primary target; never replace it with row role=button or a tab stop.
Keep secondary controls independent; use data-action-delegate-ignore for custom interactive descendants, and do not nest delegates.
Modified and middle clicks on blank row space are not delegated; use the actual link for native navigation affordances.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using delegation to hide or omit a real primary control.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep the primary action visible, named and reachable through normal keyboard navigation.

validation: Test pointer, keyboard on the real control, text selection, portals, disabled targets, cancelled pointer, modifiers, handler/ref composition and one activation.
